{{Quote|I've been planning for some time to send General Covell to take command of the Mount Tantiss garrison. As well as to supplement the troops already there. This would seem as good a time as any to do so.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
The '''Mount Tantiss garrison''' was a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] stationed on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] as part of the security for [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="TLC" />
